name: Color Dash
description: Tap to jump through spinning rings, only through your own color.

description_i18n.es: Toca para saltar a través de anillos que giran, solo por tu color.

prompt: A one-tap game like Color Switch: tap to make a ball jump upward through rotating colored rings, it can only pass through the segment of its own color, color changers between obstacles, endless levels getting faster. Make it addictive and viral: a daily challenge, streak or progress that brings people back every day, very satisfying animations, haptics with Acornix.vibrate and sounds made with Web Audio, records saved with Acornix.db, and a Share button that draws a beautiful result card on a canvas with the result, the app name and a small footer Made with Acornix, then shares it with Acornix.files.share and the file name result.png. Polished, colorful, premium design.
author: gonzaroman
